newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Lenenergo 9-mth pre-tax 152 bn rls.
newsitem.headline: Russia Lenenergo 9-mth pre-tax 152 bn rls.

text.p: Russia's AO Lenenergo 0#LSNG.RUO 9-month pre-tax profit was 152 billion roubles, the company's accountant said on Wednesday.
She did not mention Lenenergo's pre-tax profit in the first nine months of 1995. But in the whole of 1995 Lenenergo's pre-tax profit was 96.1 billion roubles.
St Petersburg tax authorities have frozen the company's accounts because of tax debts and wage arrears, and money coming into the accounts is transferred to pay wages and tax debts.
Debts to Lenenergo amounted to one trillion roubles at the end of September.

The company's main shareholders are the national power grid Unified Energy System with 60 percent of voting shares, St Petersburg administration with 17 percent and Lenenergo's employees with 29 percent.

The profit figures are prepared to Russian accounting standards, which differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Russian companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on a cash or accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
